units: Sot. 9ᵇ (play on דלילה) דִּילְדְּלָה את כחו וכ׳ she weakened his strength, his understanding, his merits; Num. R. s. 9. Tanḥ. B’har 3 מְדַלְדְּלוֹ וכ׳ the Lord reduces his income, and he must sell his property.—2) to loosen, detach.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 24b:4">Kidd. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>די׳ בו עצם</he> he loosened a tooth in the slave’s jaw.—Part. pass. <he>מְדוּלְדָּל</he>
Lev. R. s. 34 he is called dal מד׳ מן הנכסים which means detached from his property (homeless); Midr. Prov. ch. XXII דל מנכסיו (insert מדולדל).
<cite ref="Mishnah Keritot 3:8">Ker. III, 8</cite> <he>אבר המ׳</he> (Talm. ed. 15ᵃ sq. <he>המְדוּלְדֶּלֶת</he>) a limb hanging down from the body (not yet entirely detached).
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 9:7">Ḥull. IX, 7</cite> <he>האבר … המְדוּלְדָּלִין</he> limb or a part of flesh hanging down in tangles.
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Sukkah 22b">Succ. 22ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="D00069"><he>דַּבְלוּל</he></cite>. Tanḥ. Vayakhel 7 <he>עניים ומְדוּלְדָּלִים</he> poor and miserable.
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: to become thin, sparse; to be reduced.
units: Num. R. s. 5 (play on דל, Prov. XXII, 22) והם מִתְדַּלְדְּלִים וכ׳ they (the Levites) expose themselves to diminution for your sake.—2) to be detached, loosely connected, disarranged, parted into shreds. Y. Ab. Zar. V, 44ᵈ top ני׳ חותמן the berries are forcibly detached from the stalk, v. חוֹתָם.
<cite ref="Chullin 46a:11">Ḥull. 46ᵃ</cite> <he>נִידַּלְדְּלָה כבד וכ׳</he> the liver is parted into shreds and mixed up with the fat layers.

<cite ref="Chullin 44a:15">Ib. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>סימנים שנִדַּלְדְּלוּ וכ׳</he> gullet and windpipe which are torn loose from their connection so that the larger portion of their circumference is detached.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:15">Sot. IX, 15</cite> (<cite ref="Sotah 49a:17">49ᵃ</cite>) <he>נִדַּלְדְּלוּ וכ׳</he> miracle workers are not appreciated.
